title: chore(scripts): retire stale prose naming the deleted CI-failure reader
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2qdaBWhYXLTUkSnB1mr88p)_

Fixes #31758

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已删除的 CI 失败读取脚本还被 4 个脚本的 13 处注释当成"仍在用的调用方"，现在改成指向树上真实存在的调用方；审计表那一行保留原读数，只加一句"已删除"的备注；工作流命令门禁的端到端自测补了两条断言。
- 为什么改：注释说一个不存在的文件在依赖某个设计，下一个读代码的人会据此保留或误改设计；端到端自测原来在样本输出不含令牌时也会空过。
- 风险与回滚：除一个自测标签去掉括号后缀、一个自测电池加两条断言外不改任何代码路径；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs`（新增两条断言与下限 5→7）、`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`（L934、L20807 两段设计说明的改写）、`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`（L2203、L2213 历史读数）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs --self-test`，预期 exit 0，末行写 "8 declared batteries, 40 cases registered"；再跑 `grep -rn ci-failure scripts/ .github/ docs/`，预期只剩审计表那一行。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (8 mentions): the docblock at L934 now names the live importer of `classifyTransportProbe` (`scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs`) and this script's own probe as the first-stage callers the optional `repo` stage keeps identical. L1029 names `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` as an importer that never calls `resolveSweepRepo`. L20807: no live caller omits `transport` any more, so the sentence now says the identity serves the self-test's bare-observation fixtures, where it is pinned. The four self-test comments (L30492, L30540, L30596, L30651) name `check-handover.mjs` as the other importer that runs no sweep of its own. The L36754 self-test label loses its `(ci-failure.mjs)` suffix; the asserted value is unchanged.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (2): the dated price measurement keeps its numbers and calls the deleted reader "a PM Actions-failure reader … deleted since, PR #31752".
- `scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs` (1): the importer of `EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET` is now `pm/board-snapshot.mjs` and others.
- `scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs` (1): the parenthetical example naming the deleted tool is dropped; the sentence holds without it.
- `docs/audits/2026-09-self-test-shape-census.md` L376: the dated row is kept, with a trailing "(note: tool deleted in #31752)".
- `scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs`, battery `end to end on a real self-test that prints workflow-command prose`: N1 asserts that the output of `scripts/ci/lane-verdict.mjs --self-test` still carries a mid-line workflow-command token, so the clean scan cannot pass vacuously on token-free output. N2 asserts that the target is in `collectPopulation().population`. The battery floor rises 5 → 7 (measured: 7 cases; total 38 → 40).

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 8 batteries, 40 cases.
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/import-prerequisite.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (76 cases).
- `node scripts/check-workflow-step-name-quoting.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (25 assertions, 7 batteries).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Design arguments that only the deleted importer needed: one, the `transport`-absent identity in `classifyTransportProbe`'s docblock (L20807). The identity still holds and is still pinned, but it no longer protects a live caller; the sentence now says so instead of naming one. Every other argument still holds through a live importer (`check-handover.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, `board-snapshot.mjs`).
- `grep -rn ci-failure scripts/ .github/ docs/` after the change: 1 line, the audit row with its note (13 before, on `main` `01cbbba5`).

## Verification

Derived gate set (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, at `28fd60b4`, the one content commit): 69 families derived, 69 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation exit 0 ("69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED"). Six of them (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) first answered exit 3 (prerequisite not met) and were re-run after a full `turbo run build` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0). Head `aa9dc34a` adds only a merge of `main` (`6be71abc`), which touches none of the six edited files; the edited battery's self-test was re-run there: exit 0, 40 cases.
